# Sum

Adds up the numbers in an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Sum(values)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | array | The array of numbers. A null element is skipped; any other element that is not a number is a runtime error. Null is read as an empty array, and a value that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. The total of the numbers; 0 when the array holds none. The total is exact when every number is exact and the total can be held exactly; otherwise the numbers are added in order as floating-point values. A total too large to hold, such as `Sum([1e300, 1e300])`, is a runtime error. Never null.

## Example

`Sum([1, 2, null, 4])` returns `7`.

`Sum([])` returns `0`.
